notes.title: Exovia Demo - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Good Morning, Pioneers!

We are very happy that so many of you have tried out our Demo. Thank you so much for playing and for sharing your experiences, suggestions and feedback with us!

Since some of you reported critical issues with the game, we updated the Demo to address them:

- Fixed a critical audio bug that could cause the game to stutter and then become unplayable
- Tweaked postprocessing to improve performance
- Improved cursor readability

We are aware that the performance of the Demo is not optimized. These fixes should make the Demo playable again for those who experienced critical issues. We will of course work on optimizing the game, specifically the physics, for the final product.

Thank you so much for playing! 


Always remember: We are Exovia. We solve one problem. And then the next.
